profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | .Net Core | Springboot | Node | React | Angular | AWS | AI Agents
profile.summary:
Primary skills
Front end: HTML, CSS, SASS, JavaScript, jQuery, D3js, Angular, React
Back end: Nodejs
Database: MongoDB
Source Control: Git
Testing frameworks: Mocha, Enzyme
Third party libraries: Gulp, Webpack

Full stack developer with an interest in working with Angular, React, D3,  Express, Node, and Mongo.

Leveraging a professional background in Graphic design and marketing to create beautiful and functional applications. Recently completed an intensive full stack web development program at Thinkful to strengthen my coding skills.

Check out my portfolio at:

https://alvaro911.github.io/dev_portfolio/

Open to opportunities in Denver, Seattle, and working remotely.

I'd love to hear from you!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Designed and built backend services supporting distributed, high-scale enterprise systems.
· Developed REST APIs enabling integration across multiple internal platforms.
· Improved system observability and monitoring, reducing production issue resolution time.
· Collaborated with product and engineering teams to deliver scalable features.
· Participated in debugging complex production issues and improving reliability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Built backend services using Node, TypeScript and .NET Core.
· Designed and implemented API-driven systems and integrations with third party services.
· Developed asynchronous workflows using AWS Lambda.
· Worked with PostgreSQL and relational data models for scalable applications.
· Improved backend performance and optimized system efficiency for production workloads.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Developed backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
· Improved performance and reduced latency in distributed systems.
· Contributed to scalable service architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Built backend services using .NET Core (C#) for healthcare applications supporting patient-facing workflows.
· Developed APIs powering patient interactions and system integrations while ensuring secure handling of PHI in a HIPAA-compliant environment.
· Collaborated with product and operations teams to deliver reliable, compliant features aligned with clinical and operational needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
RMS
- Built reusable components for catastrophy analysis application
- The position is 100% remote with a team of offshore engineers
- Technologies and libraries used: React hooks, redux, ant design, ramda, recharts

positions.title: Software Team Lead
positions.description:
· Led development of full-stack applications and backend services.
· Mentored engineers and conducted code reviews.
· Helped establish engineering best practices.

positions.title: Graphic Designer/ Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop websites, animations, interactive tutorials and applications.

Produce videos used in websites and promotional explainers about the company.

Create and maintain brand identity and style guide

Design presentations for conferences or tech talks

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Was in charge of creating marketing materials like flyers, brochures and html emails to help real estate agents market their properties. 

I also created single page websites, forms and produced videos for events and large properties.

positions.title: Editorial support
positions.description:
Worked as Content builder, Voice actor and Editorial support for the Competency and Fluency Spanish team product line.

• As a Content builder I was in charge of laying out the elements the content specialists would suggest in the different kind of activities the course offered, making them look clean and easy for students and teachers to under- stand improving their user experience. I also created artwork, like mock up magazine covers in spanish and graphic charts, as visual support for the written content, and make activities more interactive.

• As Editorial support I was in charge of: looking at other Content builders layout, fixing and occasionally re-designing the look of the activity completely if needed.

• As a Voice actor, I participated in recording sessions for vocabulary and authenticity purposes.
